claim.text: Grouped-query attention lets several queries share one key and value, so the KV cache grows with the number of KV heads

spec.explain: Toy illustration for arXiv 2305.13245 grouped-query attention: watch the group_size number to see how many queries share each KV block while kv_cache only follows KV heads.

questions.q: Predict what happens to kv_cache if kv_heads is 1?
questions.why: Tests cache dependence on KV heads.

questions.q: What is group_size when q_heads is 32 and kv_heads is 1?
How does kv_cache change if seq_len is 128?
Why does q_heads 16 still share blocks when kv_heads is 2?

widget.draw: function draw(ctx, state, t) { var w = state.w; var h = state.h; var q = state.q_heads; var kv = state.kv_heads; var seq = state.seq_len; function fmt(v) { return Math.round(v * 100) / 100; } ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#1f2933"; ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic"; ctx.fillText("queries on top share KV blocks below", 40, 28); var group_size = q / kv; var kv_cache = kv * seq; var i = 0; var j = 0; var cols = 16; var bw = 28; var bh = 20; var gx = 40; var gy = 48; var g = 0; var c0 = "#1f4b99"; var c1 = "#c4512c"; for (i = 0; i < q; i++) { g = Math.floor(i / group_size); if (g === 0) { ctx.fillStyle = c0; } else { ctx.fillStyle = c1; } var cx = gx + (i % cols) * bw; var cy = gy + Math.floor(i / cols) * (bh + 6); ctx.fillRect(cx, cy, 22, bh); } var kx = 40; var ky = 170; var maxW = 520; var kw = seq * 4; if (kw > maxW) { kw = maxW; } for (j = 0; j < kv; j++) { if (j === 0) { ctx.fillStyle = c0; } else { ctx.fillStyle = c1; } var ky2 = ky + j * 52; ctx.fillRect(kx, ky2, kw, 34); ctx.fillStyle = "#1f2933"; ctx.strokeStyle = "#1f2933"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(kx, ky2, kw, 34); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(gx + 40, gy + 50); ctx.lineTo(kx + 20, ky2 + 17); ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(gx + 440, gy + 50); ctx.lineTo(kx + kw - 20, ky2 + 17); ctx.stroke(); } ctx.fillStyle = "#1f2933"; ctx.fillText("group_size = " + fmt(group_size), 40, 310); ctx.fillText("kv_cache = " + fmt(kv_cache), 240, 310); ctx.fillText("not to scale", 440, 310); }
